# Dorchester 101 (DOR101) — llms.txt
# Guidance for AI crawlers, per https://llmstxt.org/
# This file tells automated agents what DOR101 is and where its data lives.
# It does NOT grant rights to republish restricted content — all pages carry
# standard copyright + MIT code licence; photographs are under their own CC licences.

Name: Dorchester 101 (DOR101)
URL: https://dorchester-101.vercel.app
Description: Free housing, food open now, a live MBTA map with real buses and trains, live Boston weather with storm warnings and what-to-wear advice, and free winter coats and clothing for Dorchester, Boston — in nine languages, with each listing's verification date.
Author: Yeisbel (https://github.com/Nikoxkx)
Licence: MIT (code) — see /LICENSE ; photographs credited individually in /public/IMAGE-CREDITS.md

## Data sources (official, not scraped)
- City of Boston open data: data.boston.gov
- U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-year (2020–2024): data.census.gov + api.census.gov
- HUD FY2026 income limits + Fair Market Rents: huduser.gov
- MBTA real-time GTFS-realtime CDN (arrivals, alerts, live vehicle GPS positions) + v3 API: cdn.mbta.com / api-v3.mbta.com
- National Weather Service: api.weather.gov (forecast, warnings, station observations); Open-Meteo labelled backup
- News RSS: Dorchester Reporter (/feed/), City of Boston news (/rss/news), WBUR (rss.wbur.org), Boston Globe ARC feed
- Map tiles: Esri World Imagery (services.arcgisonline.com), OpenStreetMap

## API (public, rate-limited)
Docs: https://dorchester-101.vercel.app/api/docs
All endpoints are public JSON; no auth. Rate-limit and cache headers are set per route.
Do not abuse the MBTA or Census endpoints — use the cached /api/* instead.

Sitemap: https://dorchester-101.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
